sentences.text: 1. This application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioners in connection with Rairakhol P.S. Case No. 227 of 2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 543 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M., Rairakhol under Sections 417, 493, 376(1), 294, 506, 354, 34 of IPC.

2. Mr. N. Mohapatra, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that there is allegation in the FIR that the case has been registered because the family members as the petitioner did not agree for his marriage with the victim on account of objection of his mother and sister.
He submits that the petitioner is prepared to marry the victim girl.

3. List this case on 29.11.2023 to enable Mr. D.K. Mishra, learned Addl. Govt. Advocate to obtain instructions to the I.I.C., Rairakhol Police Station if the victim is still prepared to marry the petitioner.
Mr. N. Mohapatra, learned counsel for the petitioner if the marriage of the petitioner and victim is going to be solemnized.
(S  Sukanta Jud Signed by: SUKANTA KUMAR BEHERA Sudam Munda vs State Of Odisha ..... Opp.
